title:
I need a detailed analysis and plan for organizing 64 flake repos into a buildable hierarchy. Here's the context:

We're at `/mnt/data1/time-2026/02-february/22/dasl/` — this is the DASL project root.

We have a `package-flakes` Rust tool (in `test-build/`) that discovered 64 unique git repos with `flake.nix` files (43 have local mirrors, 21 missing). These were found from `~/dasl/nix.txt`.

The repos fall into several categories:
- Local DASL Rust crates: `rust/serde_ipld_dagcbor`, `rust/n0_dasl`, `rust/ipld-core/*` (fuzzing tools)
- External Rust deps: `rust/fedimint`, `rust/honggfuzz-rs`
- Solana repos: `INPUT/DASL2/dasl2_encoding_proof`, `IMPL/clean_project/flakes/lang/js-dag-cbor`, `IMPL/crate2nix-zos/vendor/erdfa-publish/sidechain`
- Atproto ecosystem: 30+ repos under `IMPL/users/atproto/atproto_repos/` (many small Rust, Nim, JS projects)
- Everparse/F*: `IMPL/everparse`, `IMPL/everparse/opt/karamel`, `IMPL/everparse/opt/FStar`, `IMPL/mjschwenne-everparse`
- Crate2nix: `IMPL/crate2nix-zos/vendor/crate2nix`
- Escaped-RDFa: `IMPL/crate2nix-zos/vendor/escaped-rdfa`
- Other: `IMPL/jacquard`, `IMPL/learn-languages/lean`, `dasl-testing/js`, `data/fedimint`

The user wants to:
1. "Organize these flakes into a hierarchy" — group by domain/category, create flake input groups
2. "Get them all to build" — integrate as buildable packages in the main flake

The notes mention:
- "one decl per crate per nix" — modular crate declarations
- Using `~/projects/crate2nix-zos` as template
- Using `~/projects/cargo-clean/tools/cargo-vendormod/` to manage subdirs
- "each change can be a minimal build with just the decls it needs materialized"

Key observations from reading sample flakes:
- Most are Rust crates using `pkgs.rustPlatform.buildRustPackage`
- Some are non-Rust: MiniZinc proof, mdBook docs, JS/Bun, Python
- Some use complex flake architectures (flake-parts, rust-flake, etc.)
- The crate2nix-zos template uses crate2nix for Rust crate management

I need a plan for:
1. How to categorize the 64 repos into domain groups
2. How to structure the main flake.nix to include them all as inputs and outputs
3. How to handle the 21 missing mirrors (what needs to be synced)
4. A proposed hierarchy structure (files/directories/modules)
5. What build approach to use for each category (crate2nix, buildRustPackage, etc.)

Focus on the practical structure — what files to create, how to organize the flake inputs, and how to wire up the outputs. The user wants this to actually build.
